sentences.text: Javier toma los apuntes en un cuaderno de espiral.
sentences.en: Javier takes notes in a spiral notebook.
sentences.ko: 하비에르는 스프링 노트에 필기해요.

sentences.text: La carretera subía en espiral hasta el puerto y Marta acabó mareada.
sentences.en: The road climbed in a spiral up to the pass and Marta ended up carsick.
sentences.ko: 길이 고개까지 빙글빙글 올라가서 마르타는 결국 멀미를 했어요.

sentences.text: En la novela que leyó Javier, un antiguo pandillero acaba siendo maestro.
sentences.en: In the novel Javier read, a former gang member ends up becoming a teacher.
sentences.ko: 하비에르가 읽은 소설에서 옛 갱단원이 결국 선생님이 돼요.

sentences.text: En la película que vio Marta en el motel, un pandillero huía por la autopista.
sentences.en: In the film Marta watched at the motel, a gang member was fleeing along the motorway.
sentences.ko: 마르타가 모텔에서 본 영화에서 갱단원 한 명이 고속도로로 달아났어요.
